summary: Frontend-only verification of the new 'Email customer' button on the calibration certificate block in the OFFICE Service Case drawer (SVC-00001). Logged in as owner@isodemo.com, navigated Service Desk -> Cases, opened SVC-00001. Verified three buttons + PASS pill, exercised the email flow with two sequential window.prompt dialogs, and confirmed View/Download regression still work.
critical_code_review_comments: Email flow uses native window.prompt() twice (email + note). Works, but a small shadcn dialog with an email input + textarea would be a better UX and easier to test/style. Non-blocking.
test_credentials: owner@isodemo.com / IsoDemo123! (no MFA) — Service Desk operator, org iso-demo-org.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sidebar link 'Cases' is a tab switcher on /service-desk (not a route). Navigate to /service-desk?tab=cases then click SVC-00001 to open the drawer. Calibration cert block lives in the drawer footer. Sonner toast may auto-dismiss within ~4s, so query the DOM soon after the fetch resolves if you need to assert its text.

email_flow.dialog_1: prompt 'Send the calibration certificate to which email?' default='facilities@isodemo.test' — accepted with 'facilities@isodemo.test'
email_flow.dialog_2: prompt 'Add a short note (optional)' default='' — accepted with ''
email_flow.network: POST /api/svc/cases/55107804-cc36-49f5-ae6c-834f4778704c/calibration/certificate/email -> HTTP 502 (expected, Resend key invalid in preview)
email_flow.ui_state: No crash / blank screen (body innerText length = 2576 chars, drawer still rendered). Sent pill did NOT appear (correct — server call failed). Error toast likely fired but auto-dismissed before DOM query (non-blocking).

rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. 502 from /calibration/certificate/email is by design (Resend delivery mocked in preview) and the UI handles it gracefully.
